data.overview: MCU development board hosts firmware that toggles an on-board LED. Host Linux device builds and programs via Device Broker. Runtime evidence is observed via supported serial/debug interface when present.
data_flows: Host build → firmware artifact → programmer → MCU flash
hardware_software_allocation: LED physical pin mapping owned by hardware design / board profile
Blink timing and startup signature owned by firmware
constraints: L3 programming only with Broker approval
trade_offs: Zephyr blinky template vs bare-metal — prefer supported SDK from board profile
open_decisions: Exact LED pin if board profile does not define it
